name: Mr.Xiaomian noodle bar
reviews: I’ve been here for quite a few times now and the meat portion is still too small. Compared to the large amount of noodles in a bowl you should have put more braised beef in it. I can barely see the meat underneath the vegetables lol. Otherwise the soup is delicious and the noodles are top tier.

A great new taste addition to Anzac parade. Mr.Xiaomian offers some fragrant and delicious noodles soups at an extremely low price. The recommended Chongqing xiao mian is definitely worth a try. This restaurant also offers free unlimited pork bone soup on the side and a large variety of spicy and non spicy noodle and rice dishes.
My favorite place to get noodles which is tasty and budget friendly. Chongqing XiaoMian forever 🙌
The soup stock could use some more seasoning and the noodles are a little over cooked. However, if you need an affordable hot bowl of spicy noodles for a quick meal, this is the right place.
This place is off the hook. Incredible noodles with all of the fixings. My mouth tingles with anticipation at the mere thought of visiting.
